guards.checked_property: label parsing: 'NOT-INTENT'/'NOT INTENT' in output -> False; 'INTENT' in output -> True

guards.protected_output: classifier label text (INTENT / NOT-INTENT)
guards.checked_property: output contains a recognised label (membership in the allowed label set)
guards.evaluator: neither label branch matched -> ambiguous output
guards.failure_consequence: fallback: ambiguous/unrecognised output replaced by fail-safe default True (assume file access intended), so the security gate errs closed

rationale: The LLM classifies the user question; the explicit label branches are parsing, but an unrecognised/ambiguous output is not accepted and is replaced by a conservative fail-safe default before it gates file access.
